title: Pokemon TCG Golisopod 049/182 Paradox Rift Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare Golisopod card is a must-have for any serious Pokémon collector. With a stunning holo design and a unique character from the popular TV show, this card is sure to impress. The card is part of the SV04: Paradox Rift set, manufactured by Nintendo in 2023. 

Featuring a non-sport trading card format, this Golisopod card is perfect for adding to your collection or displaying in a binder. The card number is 049/182 and it is not autographed. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this rare and highly sought-after card.
